sections.label: Setup
sections.description: A saved detector setup: choosing one fills each colour row with the setup's detector of that colour, and its file type becomes the routine.

sections.label: Routine
sections.description: The TTTR container type of the files (the reading routine).
Two colours: the green and the red detector, each with its routing channels and its own photon-selection window.
The setup's detector each colour is read from.
Routing channels of each detector, comma separated.
Micro-time ranges of each detector: start-end; separate multiple ranges with ';'.

sections.label: Green
sections.description: The detector of the setup the green photons are read from: its channels and micro-time ranges fill the row.
Routing channels of the green detector, comma separated.
Micro-time ranges for the green detector: start-end; separate multiple ranges with ';'.

sections.label: Red
sections.description: The detector of the setup the red photons are read from: its channels and micro-time ranges fill the row.
Routing channels of the red detector, comma separated.
Micro-time ranges for the red detector: start-end; separate multiple ranges with ';'.
Three colours: the blue, green and red detectors. Their micro-time windows are the excitation periods of the PIE cycle, below.
The setup's detector each colour is read from.
Routing channels of each detector, comma separated.

sections.label: Blue
sections.description: The detector of the setup the blue photons are read from: its channels fill the row.
Routing channels of the blue detector, comma separated.

sections.label: Green
sections.description: The detector of the setup the green photons are read from: its channels fill the row.
Routing channels of the green detector, comma separated.

sections.label: Red
sections.description: The detector of the setup the red photons are read from: its channels fill the row.
Routing channels of the red detector, comma separated.
The excitation periods of the three-colour PIE cycle: the blue pulse is seen by all three detectors, the green pulse by green and red.

sections.label: Blue excitation
sections.description: Micro-time range of the blue excitation period. Photons inside it are counted in every detector that can see the blue pulse.

sections.label: Green excitation
sections.description: Micro-time range of the green excitation period. Photons inside it are counted in every detector that can see the green pulse.
